svg.title: eval-agent — System Design
svg.text: Long-running Gemini-based evaluation harness for the MHM Pipeline · file-coupled (no Python imports across the boundary) · Anthropic-style two-agent harness

g.text: run · verify · diff · recover · calibrate · report · doctor
colour-coded UI · in-place progress bar · NO_COLOR / TTY auto-detect
startup() — git log · progress.md tail · safety preamble
execute() — extract candidates · cache-aware judge · parallel
checkpoint(verdicts) — write per-run artefacts under state/runs/
finalize() — append session block to progress.md
Pro-safe rate limits auto-applied when judge id contains "pro"
Pro free tier ≈ 10 RPM · Flash ≈ 150 RPM
emitted by calibrate · consumed by the pipeline's auto-approve UI
cleared only by `rm` · rebuildable via recover
DEBUG file logs · 7-day TTL prune on init

svg.text: cache append · feature_list update · progress.md tail
